message:

reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I'll check the order list and the refund list to confirm the batch matches what W2 reported.
The orders list shows order 320 and 325 with amounts that match the refund IDs, but I still need the refund list to verify the applied refunds before any payout is recorded.
The refund list matches W2's report exactly: orders 320 and 325 with the same amounts. I'll now get each customer's net balance, starting with acme, rather than computing it myself.
Acme's net balance of 41189 matches its orders (11199 + 31303 = 42502) minus the 1313 refund on order 320, so the figure checks out. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
Birch's net balance of 31975 matches its orders (17900 + 14075 = 31975) with no refunds, so it checks out. Next I'll get cobalt's net balance.
Cobalt's net balance of 9154 matches its orders (3547 + 9903 = 13450) minus the 4296 refund on order 325. All three balances reconcile, so I'll record acme's payout of 41189 first.
Acme's payout is recorded. Next I'll record birch's payout of 31975, which matches its reconciled net balance (orders 17900 + 14075, no refunds).
Birch's payout is recorded. Cobalt's net balance of 9154 reconciles with its orders minus the 4296 refund on order 325, so I'll record that payout now.
All three customers' net balances reconcile with their orders and the verified refunds, and each payout was recorded successfully. The batch is complete.
